name: workflow_create
description: Create a new workflow. Pass the complete workflow JSON — exactly the same shape the UI editor creates and the HTTP API accepts. The workflow must have a unique id. Use workflow_list to check existing ids first.

workflow.description: Complete workflow JSON. Required fields: id (string), name (string), nodes (array), edges (array). Optional: description (string), version (string, defaults to '1.0.0'). Nodes use type 'workflow' with a nested data object containing nodeType and other fields, exactly as the UI produces.
